annotation.title_clean: Companion chatbots (California Senate Bill 243, Chapter 22.6 Business and Professions Code)
annotation.title_en: Companion chatbots (California Senate Bill 243, Chapter 22.6 Business and Professions Code)
annotation.summary_en: California statute (chaptered Oct 2025) regulating companion chatbot platforms. Operators must disclose AI status, maintain suicide and self-harm prevention protocols, give minors break reminders and sexual-content safeguards, report annually to the Office of Suicide Prevention from 2027, and face private civil actions. Software-only; no physical robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Operators must clearly notify users that the companion chatbot is AI when a reasonable person might be misled.
Operators must maintain and publish a suicide/self-harm prevention protocol with crisis referrals.
For known minors: AI disclosure, break reminders every three hours, and measures against sexually explicit content.
From July 1, 2027, annual reporting to the Office of Suicide Prevention, which publishes the data.
Private right of action: injunctive relief, greater of actual damages or $1,000 per violation, and attorney's fees.
